name: tarbase

download_files.notes: POST endpoint (not a static GET file); requires a JSON body (an empty object {} returns the unfiltered full dataset). Verified live during this session: HTTP 200, content-type text/csv, 1,847,088 data rows, no auth, no login wall.

license.observed_site: No explicit license page found on the SPA; PMC article states CC BY 4.0 and Crossref license metadata independently confirms CC BY 4.0

redundant_fields: gene_name (available via MyGene.info from gene_id, kept for convenience/readability)

endpoints: get_all_interactions/ (POST, JSON body {} = unfiltered, single response = full dataset as CSV blob)
api_crawl_details.pagination: none required — single POST with empty filter body returns all 1,847,088 rows in one response
api_crawl_details.rate_limits: not documented; no throttling observed for a single ~115MB request in this session
api_crawl_details.response_shape: text/csv blob (not JSON) with header row: gene_name,gene_id,mirna_name,mirna_id,experiments,publications,cell_lines,micro_tscore

paper_vs_reality.observed: 1,847,088 rows in the aggregated pair-level export
confirmed — export includes hsa (human), ssc (pig, e.g. Sus scrofa Ensembl IDs ENSSSCG...), and other species prefixes

paper_vs_reality.claim: 37 experimental protocols, 103+ tissues, 57 cell-types, publication/sample-level metadata
paper_vs_reality.observed: NOT present in the pair-level aggregate export (only summary counts: experiments/publications/cell_lines); full per-experiment detail would require crawling get_interactions/ or get_interaction_site/ per pair, not attempted

risks: The paper's ~6M 'total entries' figure refers to per-experiment/per-sample interaction records; the bulk export used here is a coarser, pair-level aggregation (~1.85M rows) that matches the paper's ~2M unique-pairs figure but loses per-experiment granularity (tissue, cell-type, method, PMID, genomic coordinates).

get_all_interactions/ is an internal SPA API route discovered by reading the compiled JS bundle (https://dianalab.e-ce.uth.gr/tarbasev9/static/js/main.c6e27c3d.js), not a documented/published bulk-download endpoint — no stability guarantee across future site releases.
7,103 duplicate (gene_id, mirna_id) pairs in the raw export (different gene_name synonyms mapping to the same Ensembl ID) require dedup in the parser.
